_readme: Descriptions for the Variables and Switches of Pokemon Z, shown in the Game state tab.
Hand-written entries are the ones without "gen": true. Entries marked "gen": true are
written by tools/gen-annotations.js from the dominant map of each id and are safe to
regenerate; hand-written entries are never overwritten.
Fields: g = group key, es/en = { n: label, d: description }, tag = editorial tags only.
Mechanical tags (script, dead, wide, reserved, computed) are derived at build time from
the cross-reference, so they cannot go stale here. Every claim traces to a line in
en is omitted while there is no English build of the game; the UI falls back to es.
